column2: @@EN@@ Free on Android, Windows and Linux.
@@EN@@ Book, move and settle every parcel — one courier OS on your own devices.
@@EN@@ Parties, books, COD, labels, AWB pools, tracking, riders and billing — the full counter-to-settled loop, with or without the internet. Free on your devices.
@@EN@@ Actual and volumetric, side by side.
@@EN@@ Your rate card, cash or account.
@@EN@@ One tap clears the counter for the next walk-in.
@@EN@@ Scroll — the parcel journey rail above tracks where you are in the story.
@@EN@@ Actual or volumetric — whichever is higher, rounded your way.
@@EN@@ The box's size sets the charge.
@@EN@@ Higher of the two, rounded up to the next 0.5 kg.
@@EN@@ In the app the divisor, the rounding step and your units (cm or inches, kg or lb) are the shop's to set. The International chip switches ÷6000 for one booking without touching Settings.
@@EN@@ Your rate cards, your party rates — and your margin on every docket.
@@EN@@ First slab and each extra slab, per zone and service.
@@EN@@ Regular senders get their rates; the default card covers everyone else.
@@EN@@ Your sell price against the carrier's price, on every docket.
@@EN@@ AWB from your own number pools. Label, scan, find.
@@EN@@ Enter each carrier's start–end series once; every booking takes the next number.
@@EN@@ The AWB goes on the box as a barcode and in plain digits.
@@EN@@ Scan a label to open its docket and act on it.
@@EN@@ Hand it to a carrier, or send your own rider. Same system.
@@EN@@ The manifest holds exactly the parcels you picked — all of them or none. A parcel booked with another carrier cannot slip into this bag.
@@EN@@ Pick the parcels, print the run sheet, and the rider works from the same app in rider mode — proof of delivery included.
@@EN@@ Every move recorded — and only moves that make sense.
@@EN@@ Booked → With carrier → Out for delivery → Delivered
@@EN@@ → reason → out again, or return to sender.

@@EN@@ A photo and the receiver's signature on the docket.
@@EN@@ Reasons, attempts, out again, or back to the sender.
@@EN@@ COD you can see: expected, handed in, owed to each consignor.
@@EN@@ Short ₹ 200 on Rider B — named, not lost in a total.
@@EN@@ Collected against paid out, per consignor, with remittance batches.
@@EN@@ Expected against handed in, and the commission slip.
@@EN@@ Day book, month bill per account, and a GST summary CSV for your accountant.
@@EN@@ Booking, labels, scanning, COD and the books all run on your devices. When the internet drops, nothing at the counter waits for it.
